newsitem.title: USA: Kemp warns against against protectionist policies.
newsitem.headline: Kemp warns against against protectionist policies.

text.p: Former U.S. Congressman Jack Kemp on Monday criticized forces within his party who are calling for tariffs on Chinese goods and services.
The Republican party must "put its arms around the world," he said, calling those who would move against Chinese imports the "forces of darkness" within the party.
He made the comments at a transportation conference in Des Moines.
"We cannot escape the global economy," the 1996 vice presidential nominee said.

Taking away most favored nation trade status from China would "raise the tariffs on Chinese goods and services back to what they were under Smoot-Hawley in 1930 and '31 when our party made the terrible mistake of raising tariffs on the edge of a recession which turned it into a depression," Kemp said.
